reviewScope: Complete lexical candidate review of the configurator keyboard-shortcuts runtime. All candidates are selectors, event/state values, accessibility attributes, motion preferences or navigation invariant diagnostics; they are not user-visible prose in current product call sites.
limitations: Inventory only; keyboard navigation behavior and locale resources remain unchanged.
Invariant messages are exposed only through the module diagnostic API; current application call sites do not display them.
